3/5.note: Shared pool: lines 3 and 5 share one pool of courses numbered as line 3, and line 5 is never recorded on its own. Both run Fibichova – U Kapličky (3 every 15 min, 25 min each way; 5 every 30 min on a shorter route, 15 min each way). They run at different intervals, so one alternating circulation cannot work, and in Simutrans they are two lines that draw on the same bidirectional sets. U Kapličky is a stub, so only EVO1/o and VarioLF plus/o sets can run here.
